This note cannot see or verify the host ledger.

Scope correction from FLOW.md: generic deliver guards selected text artifacts only, not binary handoffs. The MCP path is different. It gates publication of the whole worker /output directory, including binary files such as a release ZIP, into later result history, together with stdout and stderr. That content check covers the serialized tool response. It does not semantically inspect arbitrary binary contents.
